name: Onion

high.description: Even small amounts are high FODMAP

siboNotes: Onions are one of the highest FODMAP foods and should be strictly avoided during SIBO treatment. There is NO safe low-FODMAP serving size. Even onion powder and dried onion flakes must be avoided. Check ingredient labels carefully as onion is hidden in many prepared foods.
preparationTips: Use green parts of scallions as alternative
Garlic-infused oil does not contain fructans (oil-soluble, not water-soluble)
Asafoetida powder can provide similar savory flavor
